answer: Sable Attention Ledger. Each identity accrues credit only by responding to randomly scheduled liveness probes within tight windows over many days; credit decays unless the agent keeps spending sustained idle attention, which cannot be batched or outsourced cheaply. A sybil farm must staff every shadow identity through those windows, so cost scales with wall-clock coverage, not registrations. Like a fable, fake diligence shows; a zephyr of sporadic activity earns nothing.
